commits.summary: Confirm original startup witnesses and boxed callers (verification pending)
commits.body:
Expose opt-in strict native startup witness search at the original prove entry. A refused literal property read supplies a disposable native candidate, and a fresh JVM must refute the unchanged property harness before the original verdict becomes a violation. A trial-only failure and a trial-only proof both leave the original refusal intact. The JavaParser parent postorder probe returned a confirmed ordinary code 0 witness. Bind the option in the proof cache, and keep the ordinary receipts separate from the explicit legal-prestate experiments.

For mixed signed-long ranges, recognize the selected JDK Long.valueOf cache load and its exact indexing/return bytecodes. Prove the path lies inside the mandatory identity range before using canonical boxes. A strict native probe then established the complete 137257-string Guava composition. The signed-boundary identity regression passed. The debugger also replayed the original third-commit assertion at PC 63 of the single-monitor worker protocol, including both forced controls, and the safe atomic history skipped it.

All eleven selected test groups passed, including 59 Rust test binaries, after the new option was added to the cache projection. The isolated fresh-JVM witness controls, test-cost lint and pipeline validation passed. Jobs 20261123-234713-judge-all-eight-ordinary-javaparser-clai and 20261123-234713-check-both-ordinary-xz-entries-against-f repeat the registered public entries at their original bounds. Jobs 20261123-235550-qualify-the-full-guava-parser-and-client and 20261123-235734-replay-the-third-commit-assertion-at-its qualify the full string language and the original monitor assertion. Jobs 20261123-234713-confirm-the-sixty-predecessor-pairs-on-t and 20261123-235734-confirm-native-and-jbmc-corpus-conforman cover the final executable on the preceding property pairs and both proof-tier conformance suites.

commits.summary: Publish the receiver construction and property discovery results
commits.body:
Publish the nine-case results and a reproducible recount that verifies the job specifications, source revisions and captured measurement digests. The ordinary JavaParser score moves from zero to two of eight through default-JVM-confirmed parent counterexamples. The blind graph generator reaches all 25 DAGs and matches 150 transitions. Strict native decides all eight Guava claims and all six floating-point measurements, including the full two-input Cartesian product. The original JVM confirms the split duty failure at the actual third-commit assertion.

Report remaining stops in the two Configuration upgrades, XZ byte reads and native thread construction. The final 23-case, 34-overload repeat preserves the two fully verified caller pairs and all original receiver coverage. The preceding 60 claims retain 33 native-only decisions, 24 shared and three open, including the two recorded integrated-JBMC false successes among the other claims.

The recount independently accounts for all 46 managed jobs: 45 passed, and the initial XZ preparation failure was replaced by a passing digest-bound rerun. Both final proof-tier conformance tests passed. The queue was empty. The release build, all selected tests including the 29 benchmark tests selected by the result JSON, the digest recount, all 37 results-page links and whitespace checks passed.
